outcome: Distribution of CS cases across Robson groups
cohort: All women who attended antenatal care or delivered in six primary health facilities (General Hospitals) across six local government areas in Sokoto state, Northwest Nigeria, between August and November 2022.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate in Sokoto State General Hospitals was 13.56%, a rate higher than the average in sub-Saharan Africa, with the commonest forms of CS falling into Robson's Group 1-4, and Group 4 having the highest proportion of cases (26.62%).
mod_finding: The study found a caesarean section rate of 13.56% in Sokoto State General Hospitals, with the most frequent caesarean deliveries classified under Robson's Group 1-4, particularly Group 4 (26.62%).
